description: This file contains functions and type definitions for interacting with Discord directories, including listing guilds, channels, and users, with filtering and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: DiscordGuild
classes.description: Represents a Discord guild with id and name.

classes.name: DiscordUser
classes.description: Represents a Discord user with id, username, optional global name, and bot status.

classes.name: DiscordMember
classes.description: Represents a Discord guild member with user info and optional nickname.

classes.name: DiscordChannel
classes.description: Represents a Discord channel with id and optional name.

classes.name: DiscordDirectoryAccess
classes.description: Contains token, query, and accountId for accessing Discord directory.

methods.name: normalizeQuery
methods.description: Trims and lowercases a string, or returns empty string if null/undefined.

methods.name: buildUserRank
methods.description: Returns 0 if user is a bot, otherwise 1.

methods.name: resolveDiscordDirectoryAccess
methods.description: Resolves directory access credentials from parameters.

methods.name: listDiscordGuilds
methods.description: Fetches and filters the list of Discord guilds for a token.

methods.name: listDiscordDirectoryGroupsLive
methods.description: Lists Discord guild channels matching a query, with optional limit.

methods.name: listDiscordDirectoryPeersLive
methods.description: Lists Discord users matching a query, with optional limit.
